static_traits.name: Chen Jing
static_traits.social_status: 社会支持系统较弱，缺乏可以讨论without能感与自责的对象
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；既往not yet有类似心理问题，not yet接受心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly, good logic, high cooperation, positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 在竞争情境中持续出现without能感与自责，这些感受在最近一次电子游戏展团队失利后加重。
basic_info.core_demands: I want to stop always feeling frustrated with myself and enjoy things again.
growth_experiences: 最近在电子游戏展团队比赛中承受高压力并最终失利，将失败归因于自身能力not足，trigger持续的without能感与自责；其后在社区团队体育活动中再度表现not佳，重复“It is all my fault”的自我归因模式，加深羞耻与Anxiety；同时缺乏强社会支持，难以向他人倾诉与获得情绪上的缓冲。

core_beliefs: 我是一个糟糕的竞争者
I am not good enough / incompetent

special_situations.event: In a team event at a video game expo, the team losing under high pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的表现not够完美，团队就会失败；失败就意味着I am very incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 赛后加倍练习、努力提升skill与表现以证明自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We lost because I am bad; I let everyone down

special_situations.event: 在社区的团队体育活动中团队表现not佳
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not如队友，就证明我not胜任、比do not人差
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度自我批评，并计划更加刻苦训练以弥补not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others，我就是not够好

special_situations.event: In any competitive activity (video games or team matches)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail once, it means I am a failure overall
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced enjoyment of interest activities, avoiding participation or over-practicing to avoid failing again

special_situations.event: 比赛过程中团队整体发挥not佳且存在外部因素影响
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须为结果负全责，若not如此就是在推卸责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Takes all responsibility onto oneself, trying to avoid failing again through control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 比赛输掉完全是因为我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable competitor and to be accepted and respected by the team
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、被归咎于失败、让他人失望
defense_goal: Through preemptive self-blame and taking excessive responsibility, reduces the risk of external criticism
Maintains safety and self-worth through perfect performance

object_relations.self_representation: 让人失望的失败者/not够好的队员
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、评判的他人或团队

object_relations.self_representation: 需要not断证明自己的not安者
object_relations.object_representation: Stronger, more outstanding others who need to be catered to

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing a lost competition in counseling or being asked about personal performance and responsibility
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously understanding the counselor's inquiries as others' scrutiny and judgment of their own ability, worrying about being blamed as the cause of failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tends to respond with self-blaming language, proactively takes excessive responsibility, cautious tone, lowers self-worth, and weakens other or situational factors

manifestations: 缺乏强有力的社会支持系统，难以与他人讨论without能感与自责
在竞争失败后独自承受羞耻与Anxiety
outcomes: Anxiety与身体紧张（胃部紧绷、全身紧张）

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: use“我应该练得更多”“我必须表现更好”之类的自我要求
Treats winning and losing as external standards that must be met and internalizes them as self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁自我责备（“It is all my fault”）
Overly harsh on oneself when exploring one's own performance, hard to acknowledge situational and team factors

exception_events.target_problem: 在竞争性活动中，来访者通常会把失败完全归因于自己，陷入羞耻与Anxiety，从而降低对活动的享受并回避参与
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在电子游戏展的部分时段，她have not一味自责，而是专注参与、与他人交流并享受过程；她学到了团队协作与压力管理，体验到一些乐趣
exception_events.reason: 线索：当与队友和参与者建立积极互动、关注学习与合作时，注意力从自我评判转向过程体验；同时现场的社交与学习机会提供了支持，使自责与Anxiety一度减轻

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to invest in change (says he is 'ready to put in the effort')
能识do not并Reflection自动化思维与认知模式（在对话中能列举证据并重构观点）
Willing to seek professional help and monitor progress
Has the ability to extract experience and meaning from failure (can see the gains in teamwork and stress management)
negative_force: Self-labeling and overgeneralization (believing 'I am a terrible competitor')
Over-personalization, blaming team failure on oneself
Lacks social support, bears pressure and self-blame alone
羞耻与Anxiety伴随明显身体紧张反应

target_behavior.behavior: 竞争情境下的过度自责与Self-denial伴随Anxiety和羞耻
antecedent: Participates in competitive activities such as video game exhibitions or team sports
比赛过程压力较大、团队整体发挥not佳或出现外部因素
target_behavior.core_reason: 形成了“I am incompetent”核心信念与认知扭曲（个人化、过度概括、比较与despair），并在Weak social support的背景下将失败全盘内归因于自身
target_behavior.function: 通过自责来获得对结果的感知控制并驱动自我加练（试图避免not yet来失败），同时回避面对他人可能的批评与复杂情绪
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、活动乐趣下降、出现Anxiety与羞耻及身体紧张，进一步影响日常生活与爱好
